# Feature Specification: Password Reset by Email

**Feature Branch**: `001-password-reset`

**Created**: 2026-10-25

**Status**: Draft

**Input**: User description: "Let users who forgot their password reset it through a link sent to their email"

## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*

### User Story 1 - Request a reset link (Priority: P1)

A user who cannot sign in asks for a password reset link by entering their email address.

**Why this priority**: Without it, locked-out users cannot recover their accounts and contact support.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by submitting the reset form with a registered email and checking that exactly one email is queued, and delivers account recovery.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a registered account with email `ana@example.com`, **When** the user submits that email on the reset form, **Then** one reset email is sent within 60 seconds
2. **Given** an email address with no account, **When** the user submits it on the reset form, **Then** the page shows the same confirmation message as for a registered address
3. **Given** a user who already requested 5 reset emails in the last hour, **When** the user submits a sixth request, **Then** 0 emails are sent and the page shows a "try again later" message

---

### User Story 2 - Set a new password from the link (Priority: P2)

A user opens the emailed link and chooses a new password.

**Why this priority**: The link is useless until the new password can be saved, but it only matters once links are being sent.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by opening a valid link, submitting a new password, and signing in with it.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a reset link issued 10 minutes ago, **When** the user submits a new password of 12 characters, **Then** the password is changed and the link can be used 0 more times
2. **Given** a reset link issued 90 minutes ago, **When** the user opens it, **Then** the page shows an expired-link message with 1 option to request a new link
3. **Given** a valid reset link, **When** the user submits a new password of 6 characters, **Then** the form is rejected with the message "minimum 8 characters"

---

### Edge Cases

- What happens when the user opens the same reset link twice?
- How does system handle an email provider outage while a reset is requested?
- What happens when the email address differs only by letter case from the stored one?

## Requirements *(mandatory)*

### Functional Requirements

- **FR-001**: System MUST send a single-use reset link to a registered email address within 60 seconds of the request
- **FR-002**: System MUST expire each reset link 60 minutes after it is issued
- **FR-003**: System MUST NOT reveal whether an email address has an account
- **FR-004**: Users MUST be able to set a new password of at least 8 characters through a valid link

### Key Entities *(include if feature involves data)*

- **Reset Token**: A single-use, time-limited credential tied to one account; carries its issue time and whether it has been used
- **Account**: The registered user identified by email address; owns the password that a reset replaces

## Success Criteria *(mandatory)*

### Measurable Outcomes

- **SC-001**: Users can complete a password reset in under 3 minutes from the request
- **SC-002**: 95% of reset emails are delivered within 60 seconds
- **SC-003**: Support tickets about locked-out accounts drop by 40% within one quarter

## Assumptions

- Users have access to the mailbox registered on their account
- Resetting a password does not sign out other devices in v1
- The existing email delivery service is reused
